sentences.text:
It is pointed out that vide order dated 09.05.2023 a coordinate bench of this Court in W.P.(CRL)
2141/2019 quashed the FIR No. 277/2018 under Sections 420/34 of the IPC at PS DBG Road, Delhi and the proceedings emanating therefrom.
5. It is pointed out that in view of the aforesaid FIR being quashed, there is no embargo with regard to the petitioners passport being renewed for Canada.

6. It is further submitted that as per the Notification No. G.S.R. 570(E) dated 25.08.1993 and OM No. VI/401/1/5/2019 dated 10.10.2019, the restrictions for the period of extension of passport are against persons who have cases pending.
7. In the present case, the said FIR already stands quashed.

8. In view thereof, learned counsel for the petitioner seeks leave to withdraw the present petition with liberty, if required, to initiate appropriate proceedings in accordance with law with respect to his renewal of the passport.

9. Leave and liberty granted.
10.
The present petition is dismissed as withdrawn and disposed of accordingly.
11. Pending application(s), if any, also stand disposed of.
AMIT SHARMA, J MAY 19, 2023/ab
